title: Pagenary Docs
description: Pagenary developer documentation — building, configuring, deploying, and extending the multi-tenant documentation publisher, published with Pagenary itself.

welcome.headline: Where documentation takes shape
welcome.lead: Pagenary turns one shared template catalog into many branded, tenant-specific static sites. This portal is built by Pagenary, from Pagenary's own docs.
pillars: Zero runtime dependencies — every published bundle is a static single-page app.
Branding and navigation are data, not code: a tenant is config plus content.
A Git-aware build pipeline rebuilds only what changed across every tenant.
checklist: Read the Quickstart to build your first bundle.
Define a tenant with config.json and a manifest.
Deploy the static output anywhere that serves files.
welcome.quote: One source of truth, any number of published sites.
